key_insight: Geometry-aware analysis yields high-probability stochastic optimization bounds whose dependence on the norm is explicit through the dual-space regularity constant κ.
engineering_relevance: Rennala NSGD extends these guarantees to semi-asynchronous distributed optimization with heterogeneous worker speeds, offering theoretical guidance for non-Euclidean training.
method: Analyze minibatch SGD for smooth nonconvex objectives in arbitrary finite-dimensional normed spaces.
Use κ-regularity and a light-tail noise condition in the update norm’s dual space.
Develop Rennala NSGD and bound wall-clock time under fixed, heterogeneous worker computation times.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports theoretical guarantees, not empirical benchmarks: Euclidean rates are recovered up to logarithmic factors, and some non-Euclidean noise models reduce linear dimension dependence to logarithmic dependence.
watch_item: Practical applicability depends on the dual-norm light-tail assumption and fixed worker-time model; the abstract does not establish empirical training gains.
paper_title: Rennala NSGD: Asynchronous Stochastic Optimization Beyond Euclidean Geometry
